Tifa and the others, caught by Rufus, are rescued just in time by the airship Highwind with Cid aboard. Now free, it flies to protect the Planet.
Talk to the crew to save, restore HP/MP or use the PHS.
A city built by Shinra, a company grown rich on Mako drawn from the Planet. At the center of the pizza-shaped city stands the 70-floor Shinra HQ.
Where Cloud first meets Aeris, selling flowers in the busy streets as passersby shove her aside.
After blowing up Reactor 1, AVALANCHE rides the train to Sector 7. At 7th Heaven Cloud meets his childhood friend Tifa, and the team plans the Reactor 5 raid.
Tifa runs this bar. Under the pinball machine is the AVALANCHE hideout.
AVALANCHE secret base, formed to fight Shinra. After Reactor 1, the next mission is to blow up Reactor 5.

A church in the ruined slums. Cloud falls from above and wakes to the voice of Aeris, whom he met in Sector 8. When Reno of the Turks comes for her, Cloud agrees to be her bodyguard and they escape over the roof.
Cloud falls from Reactor 5 into a sunlit church, where he meets Aeris again.
After falling from Reactor 5, Cloud meets Aeris again in the Sector 5 church. Hunted by the Turks, she hires him as a bodyguard to take her home.
A man with a number 2 tattoo on his arm sits silently, staring into space.
A boy has hidden 5 gil on the shelf behind the bed. Leave it alone and he will later give you a Turbo Ether.
A house ringed by flowers, where Aeris mother Elmyra waits anxiously for her. Later we learn Aeris is not her real daughter.
On top of the slide, Aeris talks about her first love. Then they see Tifa being carried off in a chocobo carriage. The fall of Sector 7 badly damaged this park too.
Cloud and Aeris follow Tifa’s carriage to Wall Market. To rescue her from Don Corneo, the rich man who runs the town, they plan to sneak into his mansion.
Inn: 10 gil (300 gil)\nStay the night to check the vending machine for the materia shop.
Inside the room Cloud sees himself huddled in a corner. He blacks out and Mukki wakes him up. A girl gives him Lingerie.
Bathe with Mukki and his pals to wash off the grime. They give you Bikini Briefs.
The bee trio carefully do their makeup, and do Cloud’s too before he dresses up.
This unmanned shop holds only broken machines.
Hand over the pharmacy coupon from the diner to get Disinfectant, Deodorant or Digestive.
For Aeris’s rescue plan Cloud dresses as a woman, in a long purple dress.
You are asked to find out what the inn’s vending machine sells. You get a Tiara as thanks.
Cooks set meals to order. Pay in advance, during the promotion you get a pharmacy coupon.
You are challenged to a squat contest. Depending on the result, the pretty guy gives you a wig.
The boutique owner’s favorite bar. Give the pharmacy medicine to the man stuck in the toilet to get Cologne, Flower Cologne or Sexy Cologne.
Buy a battery from the junk-hoarding weapon shop and climb the broken plate.
The room where Tifa is held. Aeris and Tifa meet here for the first time.
The girls Corneo did not pick are brought here, surrounded by his leering lackeys.
Womanizer Corneo picks his date for the night from Aeris, Cloud and Tifa, watched by his two men.
Where Corneo spends his nights. A trapdoor drops straight into the sewers.
Shinra’s stronghold. Keycards guard every floor and low-level staff may go no higher than 59F. Cloud and the others clear each checkpoint for keycards and head upstairs.
Hide behind the statues to slip past the guards and climb higher.
A male employee gives Keycard 62. A woman by the elevator explains the security system.
Answer Mayor Domino’s password to get Keycard 65. His greedy deputy Hart sells hints outside.
Open the doors on this floor only three times. Use the air ducts to get every item.
Work out on the gym treadmill. The Shinra gym drink never comes out of the broken machine.\nRest here to restore HP and MP.
Find the missing parts of the giant Midgar model to get Keycard 66.
Eavesdrop on the meeting below through the toilet vent and learn Hojo plans to experiment on Aeris.
Following Hojo, you find Red XIII and Jenova kept as specimens. Later you are locked in a cell on this floor.
Rescue Aeris from Hojo’s breeding experiment with Red XIII.
You are taken to President Shinra on 70F. After you are jailed, the building fills with blood and bodies, and the President is found dead, run through by Sephiroth’s long sword.

Escaping Shinra HQ, the party finally reaches the outside world. They split up and agree to meet again in the town of Kalm. Gathered at the inn, Cloud slowly begins to tell the others about his past with Sephiroth.
Cloud tells everyone what happened in Nibelheim five years ago, and about Sephiroth.
Following Sephiroth’s trail, you reach a chocobo ranch. Choco Billy says you need a chocobo to cross the serpent’s marsh, so you buy Chocobo Lure for 2000 gil.
Inn: 100 gil\nChocobo Bill explains how to cross the marsh and lends you Chocobo stalls.\nStall: 10000 gil each (up to 6)
Choco Billy sells greens for chocobo feed. His sister Chloe is a genius at judging chocobos.
Locals protecting the condor clash with the Shinra army trying to remove it. Short of fighters, they ask Cloud for money and help.\nYou can also stay here.\nInn: free
Choose between funding or fighting to defend the reactor from Shinra.
Right after meeting Priscilla playing with a dolphin, a monster attacks. She has swallowed seawater and is not breathing. An old man teaches Cloud CPR and he saves her.
A monster appears in the dolphins’ cove. Revive drowned Priscilla with CPR, then ride a dolphin jump up to Rufus’s town.
After you save Priscilla, they let you stay for free.
Change into a Shinra uniform from the locker and rehearse the parade welcoming Rufus.
Call the dolphin with Priscilla’s whistle and jump up to Junon’s airport. Mistaken for a new recruit, Cloud is pulled into the welcome ceremony for President Rufus.
Still taken for a recruit, Cloud also joins the send-off for Rufus at the harbor, then boards the Shinra cargo ship and leaves Junon.
You are brought to the press room for a public execution. Tifa is tied up in the gas room inside. As it begins, Weapon attacks.
Gas floods the room around bound Tifa. Use the buttons to escape.
Captured by Shinra, Tifa and Barret are sentenced to death by Rufus.
You head to the undersea reactor below Junon for the Huge Materia, but it is loaded onto a submarine during the fight. Cloud’s team chases it in a stolen sub.
Aboard the sub are the officer and troops from Rufus’s parade.
The cargo ship docks at Costa del Sol, a world-class resort. On the beach you meet Hojo of Shinra’s science dept. He says Sephiroth is heading west over Mt. Corel, so the party follows.
Inn: free\n   (only if you buy it)\nPresident Shinra’s old villa is for sale at 300,000 gil. Once bought it becomes Cloud’s Villa and you can stay any time.
The villa’s caretaker is always asleep.
Mukki from the Honey Bee Inn is on holiday with his club.
Johnny from the Sector 7 slums lives here with his new girlfriend. She is in the shower.
Inn: 200 gil (free)\nA cozy hotel where you fall asleep to the sound of the waves.
Hojo sunbathes surrounded by girls. Onto something about Sephiroth, he heads west to Corel.
Past the Corel reactor, the mine railway leads to Barret’s hometown, North Corel. The villagers curse and even attack Barret. The town’s tragic past, he explains, involves a dirty Shinra plot.
Barret tells of his hometown, burned by Shinra four years ago, and of his best friend Dyne.
Chasing Sephiroth, the party rides the ropeway to the Gold Saucer. Before they can relax they are caught up in a massacre, framed, and thrown into Corel Prison in the desert.
In the lobby, visited with Cait Sith, lie many shot bodies. Taken for the killers, Cloud’s group is dropped into Corel Prison by owner Dio.
Dio’s treasures from around the world are shown here, including the Keystone Cloud’s group is after.

Bookmaker’s office
(betting signup 200 gil)
 - C rank ... 100 gil
 - B rank ... 200 gil
 - A rank ... 300 gil
 - S rank ... 500 gil
Taught to ride by Ester, Cloud enters the chocobo race to free his friends.
Inn: 5 GP\nThe ropeway breaks down, so you must stay. In the lobby Cloud sums up the journey so far.
Chosen as the 100th couple of the day, the two appear in the show that follows.
Dio, owner of the Gold Saucer, tells you about the Black Materia.
Meet Cait Sith, a fortune-telling cat. Unhappy with his reading, he insists on joining you.
Barret tells of another man with a gun-arm behind the massacre: Dyne, his old friend and Marlene’s real father. Barret seeks to settle the past, but Dyne, now the prison’s boss, turns his gun on him.
Coates, who runs Corel Prison, tells you how to get out. After Dyne falls, he lets you enter the chocobo race.
Barret reveals the truth about the arena killings, and that Dyne is Marlene’s real father.

The buggy takes you to Gongaga, a village scarred by a reactor explosion. An old couple wait for their son, who left to join SOLDIER. His name is Zack: Aeris’s first love and someone Tifa knew. No one knows where he is.
The home of Zack, Aeris’s first love. A letter to his parents six or seven years ago says he found a girlfriend.

Red XIII’s hometown. Bugenhagen reveals his real name is Nanaki and tells of his brave mother and coward father. But a cave Bugenhagen leads them to shows the true form of Nanaki’s father, the warrior Seto.
Open the sealed door to show Red XIII, who hates his father, who his father really was.
Bugenhagen says Red XIII is like a human of 15 or 16. Hearing the Planet’s cries echo in the room, you learn it is in danger.
Experience the cosmos in a 3D hologram. Shooting stars and the Lifestream reveal the mysteries of Planet Life.

Cosmo Candle:
Around the fire, each ponders
questions, doubts, the truth,
and Red XIII’s anger at his father
Nibelheim, supposedly burned to the ground by Sephiroth five years ago. Men in black cloaks wander about, and the townspeople seem strange.
Five years ago Cloud came home for the first time in years and saw his mother again.
Inn: 100 gil\nZangan, a martial artist and Tifa’s teacher, cheers Cloud on as he sets off to fight monsters.
Five years ago Cloud played this piano from sheet music. Return later to get Tifa’s ultimate Limit Break, left by Zangan.
Shinra soldiers stop Tifa from entering the reactor.
In Hojo’s experiment tanks are eerie humans soaked in Mako. Seeing them, Sephiroth goes berserk with his sword.
In the coffin sleeps Vincent, still bound by the sins of his past.
Sephiroth shut himself away here reading every book to learn the secret of his birth. Learning the truth, he left, saying he was going to see his mother.
A leaning rocket stands as the town’s symbol, from the days Shinra invested in space. Cid, unable to give up his dream of space, maintains it. Shinra returns to take back Cid’s beloved Tiny Bronco.
Cid’s assistant Shera keeps the house. Their past around the rocket launch comes out.
A temple filled with the minds of the Ancients. Beyond the door opened by the Keystone is Sephiroth, seeking Meteor, the ultimate destructive magic.
Tseng of the Turks lies wounded by Sephiroth. Placing the Keystone on the altar opens the way into the temple.
Cait Sith, with his made-up body, sacrifices himself to release the Black Materia sealed in the temple.
Bone Village, famed for digging. Tell the crew where to dig and they leave the finds in the box by the entrance. You can also dig up the Lunar Harp, which wakes the Sleeping Forest.
As if guided, Aeris goes to the Ancients’ city to stop Sephiroth. As she prays calmly at the altar below the Forgotten Capital, Sephiroth’s sword...
Use the Key to the Ancients from the seabed to see Aeris’s last image in the waterfall, and learn what she wanted to tell you.
Where the fish swim, stairs to the water altar appear at night.
Controlled by Sephiroth, Cloud turns his sword on Aeris. Cloud comes to and Aeris smiles at him. Then Sephiroth drives his sword into her back.
Icicle Inn, a northern town where Dr. Gast and Ifalna once hid from Shinra. With a map and snowboard, you head for the Great Glacier.
A boy who just moved in gives you a Snowboard.
Take the Glacier Map from the wall.
Play the video to see old records of Dr. Gast and Ifalna, Aeris’s mother: happy memories, and Hojo at his worst.
Mideel, a quiet hot-spring village. Its clinic treats Cloud, who went missing in the Northern Crater. Weapon attacks the town where Cloud lies with severe Mako poisoning.
Inn: free\nCloud is treated here for severe Mako poisoning.
You try the rusty key in the back door, only to find it is a painting by the weapon shop owner.
Wutai, with the guardian Da-chao statue carved into the mountain. Yuffie hid here in her hometown with the stolen materia. After you save her from Corneo, she gives it back.
Where Yuffie first hides with the stolen materia. She takes your MP Absorb materia too.
You run into the Turks on vacation. True pros, they won’t fight even an enemy on their day off.
Yuffie, who stole the materia, hides behind the folding screen.
Catch Yuffie and ask where the materia is. Pull the lever as she says and a cage drops from the ceiling.
First foe in the Pagoda: Gorki, master of strength.
Waiting at the top is the final foe: Godo, Yuffie’s father and master of all.
Corneo hangs Yuffie and Elena upside down from Da-chao’s face.
The Ancient Forest, southeast of Cosmo Canyon. Plants that eat bugs and frogs grow here, and deep inside lie powerful weapons and materia.
On the seabed lies a Shinra Gelnika airship sunk by Weapon. Aboard is materia built to fight Sephiroth.
You run into Reno and Rude, sent to recover the anti-Sephiroth materia and weapons from the Gelnika.
With luck, the old man who is always asleep wakes up and gives you Mythril.
In the cave Vincent finds Lucrecia, Sephiroth’s mother and the woman he loved. Jenova cells have left her unable even to die, and Vincent appears before her once more.
Hand over Mythril, the weapon material, to receive one treasure.
A sage with deep knowledge of chocobos, but he forgets things fast. It takes him a long time to remember.
